title.zh: Swiss Regulator Approves First Retail Fund That Holds Bitcoin Directly
title.en: Swiss Regulator Approves First Retail Fund That Holds Bitcoin Directly

current_state.zh: Switzerland's FINMA approved the country's first retail ETF investing directly in Bitcoin, granting it an exemption from risk diversification rules based on Bitcoin's trading history and volume, while noting further Bitcoin ETF applications are pending.
current_state.en: Switzerland's FINMA approved the country's first retail ETF investing directly in Bitcoin, granting it an exemption from risk diversification rules based on Bitcoin's trading history and volume, while noting further Bitcoin ETF applications are pending.
